                                                                                                                    returns

                                                      :  :                                                         :       :
+----------------------------------------------------+:  :+-------------------------------------------------------+:       :+----------------------------------+
| note                                               |:  :| Parser                                                |:       :| Result<T>                        |
| Static ($) and abstract (*) markers should render. |:  :+-------------------------------------------------------+:       :| text(bytes=15)="Result&lt;T&gt;" |
+----------------------------------------------------+   :| +parse(text: String) : Result<String>                 |:       :| id(bytes=6)="Result"             |
                                                          | +parseAll(texts: List<String>) : List<Result<String>> |        :+----------------------------------+
                                                          | +internalHook() : bool*                               |        :| +T value                         |
                                                          +-------------------------------------------------------+         +----------------------------------+
                                                                                                                            | +isOk() : bool                   |
                                                                                                                            | +from(v: T) : Result<T>$         |
                                                                                                                            +----------------------------------+
